*** FTSE IS LIVE TODAY — AND THAT CONFIRMS THE DIAGNOSIS ***
.FTSE returned 10,537.70 stamped 11:09 BST, a genuine intraday price. On 5, 6, 7 and 8 October it returned
the previous close on every read taken between 07:54 and 08:09. This edition is publishing late because the
scheduled run hung, so the read happened three hours after the open — and the feed was fine. The lag is
confined to roughly the first half-hour after the London open, exactly as the evening reads suggested. A
second provider is needed only for editions published before about 09:00.
